title: The Green Mile
synopsis: A death row in 1935, a giant inmate who heals what he touches, and a guard who has to decide what mercy means in a green corridor.

nodes.text: A mouse on the green linoleum that everyone pretends not to see.

choices.consequence: “Leave a crumb” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Mercy.

nodes.text: Mr. Jingles is alive in a small wooden cage forty years later, and so are you, both of you tired of staying.
You leave the prison. You marry a kind woman. You wake up at night with green linoleum in your dreams. It does not let you go.
On a hill behind the prison you bury a man with hands like dinner plates. You pray for a mercy you do not believe in, and it comes anyway.
